description: Use when an agent is about to email or sign up a contact. Input: email. Output: JSON verdict (deliverable, risky, undeliverable) with reasons, MX hosts, null MX, SPF and DMARC policy, disposable domain, role account, free provider. No SMTP probe, so the mailbox itself is not verified. Malformed address refused before payment. Example: ?email=info@example.com Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.
name: email_check
title: Email check: syntax, MX, SPF/DMARC, disposable and role address, deliverability verdict
